name: CFPP2000 - French spoken in Paris, home interviews (ASR evaluation corpus)
description: Non-directive interviews about Paris neighbourhoods (about one hour each, 2 to 4 speakers), recorded in ordinary conditions (homes, cafes) and transcribed verbatim, aligned by speech turn. Used by WAMA as a REAL medium-quality corpus, to check whether the controlled degradations of SUMM-RE (`audio_degradation.PROFILES`) predict the same preprocessing results (WAMA_QUALITE 9bis). Prepared on demand by `manage.py asr_eval_corpus cfpp`. The files carry the speakers' real names: WAMA relabels them `Locuteur N` and never copies a name. Citation required by the authors: the site http://cfpp2000.univ-paris3.fr/ and Branca-Rosoff S., Fleury S., Lefeuvre F., Pires M., 2012, Discours sur la ville. Presentation du Corpus de Francais Parle Parisien des annees 2000 (CFPP2000).

splits.all: 42 recordings (mp3 + Transcriber .trs + Dublin Core metadata), about 50 h

signals.description: Verbatim transcription in Transcriber format (.trs): turns timed by Sync marks, overlapping speech marked by Who
DERIVED: the recording decoded to 16 kHz mono (media library nature `speech`)
DERIVED: the turns as SRT with `[Locuteur N]` labels, noise and pause events dropped (media library nature `document`)
